title: Tribal Totem
start: Speak to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.

recommended.t: About 90 coins (a ring of charos (a) or Karamja gloves lowers the cost)
Activated Ardougne lodestone and Karamja lodestone
An amulet of glory or a player-owned house in Brimhaven

rewards.t: 5 swordfish (if you don't have enough inventory space, they will appear on the ground)

steps.t: Talk to Kangai Mau in the large building north of Brimhaven's pub. [Chat: 2 I'm in search of adventure! › Accept]
Travel to Ardougne (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete Avast Ardougne!, an easy Karamja achievement), and head to the RPDT depot just south of the eastern bank.
Investigate the crate directly north-east of the sacks for the address label.
Use the address label on the stack of two crates directly north of the crate you just investigated.
Talk to an RPDT employee and ask when the crate will be delivered. [Chat: 1 So, when are you going to deliver this crate?]

Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the house north-east of the Ardougne market (the one with the blue checkered floor). [Chat: 2 So what have you invented? › 2 Can I be teleported please? › 1 Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!]
Once inside the mansion, open the western door, using the code "KURT" to get in.
Right-click Investigate the stairs, then Climb-up them.
Once upstairs, enter the next room, Open the chest, then Search it for a totem.
p: Retrieving the totem from the mansion.

steps.t: Talk to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven with the totem.
